Southwest General green room sandwiches.d: Egg salad with watercress, and cucumber with cream cheese, on soft white bread. Crusts off, cut in triangles.
Southwest General green room sandwiches.note: Trays sent up to the TV studios.

Sandy's audition capsicum and feta dip.d: Charred under the broiler, peeled, whipped smooth with feta, yogurt, garlic, hot chili flakes and olive oil. Sesame crackers.
Sandy's audition capsicum and feta dip.note: Zakuski, to begin at the table.

Les's farm roast chicken.d: Butter, grated lemon peel and thyme under the skin. Carved, with potatoes browned in the drippings.

Strawberry shortcake.d: Cream biscuits baked this morning, split and filled with sugared berries and soft whipped cream.

Dorothy Michaels' Russian caravan tea.d: Strong and black, poured into glasses. Lemon and cherry preserves on the side, to stir in.
